skill.name: human-writer
skill.description: Edit or assess a draft that should sound natural, direct, and authored by a person. Use for social posts, replies, documentation, emails, and public copy when removing AI writing tells without changing the writer's meaning. Edit minimally by default. Use Detect mode when the user asks for an assessment rather than a rewrite.
skill.summary: Make minimal edits that remove common machine-written patterns while preserving the writer's meaning and voice.
skill.author: glenskii

content.user_title: Edit Drafts in a Natural Human Voice
content.value_statement: AI-assisted drafts can sound generic, repetitive, or overly polished while changing the writer's intended meaning. This skill makes minimal editorial changes that remove common machine-written patterns and preserve the writer's voice.
actual_capabilities: Edits social posts, replies, documentation, emails, and public copy.
Removes common machine-written vocabulary and rhetorical patterns.
Preserves meaning, facts, formatting, tone, and distinctive voice.
Supports Edit mode for minimal changes and Detect mode for read-only findings.
Flags uncertain factual changes instead of silently rewriting them.
Checks edited drafts against a structured quality checklist.
limitations: It does not generate new copy from an empty prompt.
It does not determine whether another person used AI to write a draft.
It does not fact-check claims beyond flagging obvious errors.
It cannot verify a fact without user confirmation or a separate research process.

use_cases.title: Polish a social post
use_cases.description: Remove obvious machine-written phrasing from a post while keeping its casual rhythm, point, and formatting.

use_cases.title: Review public documentation
use_cases.description: Apply the full checklist to documentation so technical claims remain precise and the language stays direct.

use_cases.title: Audit a draft without edits
use_cases.description: Use Detect mode to identify writing patterns, quote the affected lines, and suggest concise fixes without changing the draft.

prompt_templates.title: Clean a short draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this draft for natural, direct language. Preserve its meaning, tone, facts, and line breaks. Make only minimal changes.

prompt_templates.title: Preserve a casual voice
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this social post using the lightest possible touch. Remove machine-written patterns, but keep the writer's casual rhythm, fragments, and emphasis.

prompt_templates.title: Review technical copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this documentation against the human-writer checklist. Keep every technical claim precise, remove inflated phrasing, and list any FLAG or ASK items after the revised text.

prompt_templates.title: Run a read-only audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Detect mode on this draft. Do not rewrite it or score its authorship. List each visible machine-written pattern, quote the relevant text, and give a brief suggested fix.

output_examples.input: Please edit this announcement: We are excited to leverage a robust and seamless workflow that empowers every team.
output_examples.output: We are excited to use a reliable workflow that helps every team.

output_examples.input: Detect patterns in this paragraph without changing it: In today's fast-paced landscape, this innovative approach unlocks valuable insights.
output: Suggested fix: Replace inflated terms with plain language while preserving the specific claim.

best_practices: Provide the complete draft and identify its audience or register.
State whether you want Edit mode or Detect mode.
Include the project voice profile when approved terms or punctuation rules matter.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent examples, arguments, or missing facts.
Do not use Detect mode when you want a revised draft.
Do not treat pattern findings as proof of AI authorship.

faq.question: What does this skill edit?
faq.answer: It edits existing social posts, replies, documentation, emails, and public copy.

faq.question: Does it change the writer's meaning?
faq.answer: It should not. The default behavior makes minimal changes and preserves the writer's point, facts, and voice.

faq.question: What is Detect mode?
faq.answer: Detect mode reviews the draft without rewriting it. It names visible patterns, quotes the text, and suggests brief fixes.

faq.question: Can it detect AI authorship?
faq.answer: No. It identifies writing patterns in an authorized draft, but those patterns do not prove who wrote it.

faq.question: Can it fact-check my draft?
faq.answer: It can flag an obvious factual error. It does not perform general fact-checking or silently change unverified claims.

faq.question: How should I provide a voice profile?
faq.answer: Provide approved terms, punctuation rules, audience details, and editing boundaries with the draft.
